text:
csm_jordan: heads-up: ACME reported spike of 5xx around 09:23 PST, ~30% of calls returning 503 with message 'upstream inference worker error'. Customer hitting timeouts, requests aborted. They pasted one response: "upstream inference worker crashed: signal 6". Can we triage? :frowning:

eng_oncall_amy: looking. Any request IDs or model variants?

csm_jordan: attached request id 01H8XYZ9Q and model gpt-small-8q. Happening across regions (us-west-2). They say it started after a model swap at 09:15.

infra_sre_miguel: checking infra metrics. I'm seeing GPU memory usage spike then worker SIGBUS+OOM and container restart loop on runner-az3-4. Logs show cuda error followed by killed.

ben_devex: pinging platform logs, grabbing docker logs and core from host.

carla_runtime: paste logs:
```
[2026-03-17T09:23:12Z] ERROR infer.runner: worker pid=3421 signal=6
[2026-03-17T09:23:12Z] WARN gpu0: memory spike 98% -> CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-17T09:23:12Z] INFO container: restarting infer-runner (exit=137)
```

eng_oncall_amy: can we repro in staging? miguel, any recent kernel/driver deploys?

infra_sre_miguel: no driver changes. But noticed batch size heuristic changed yesterday for gpt-small-8q (auto-batch up to 16). Looks like a regression under longer contexts.

ben_devex: quick mitigation: setting max_batch=4 and disabling kv-prefetch for that model variant stops the crash (confirmed on a repro node). Rolling a temporary routing rule to steer traffic away from affected runners.

deploy-bot: Rolled config: route.override.max_batch=4 for model gpt-small-8q -> 6 instances updated

csm_jordan: customer accepted routing fallback, but wants root cause and timeline for fix.

carla_runtime: proposed fix: revert auto-batch heuristic and add OOM guard in runtime + better fallback to smaller model variant on OOM. Will open PR.

eng_oncall_amy: next steps:
- collect full core dump + gdb backtrace from host (ben),
- add OOM guard to CI so we don't auto-increase batch for low-memory variants (carla),
- schedule postmortem and notify CS + billing if customer saw retries (miguel).

ben_devex: uploading tarball to d/s3: s3://redwood-debug/4365432100/acme-logs.tar.gz

infra_sre_miguel: marking as P1. ETA for hotfix rollout ~3 hours assuming no repro flakiness.

csm_jordan: flagged customer as P1 and offered credits. Thanks all.

eng_oncall_amy: I'll coordinate the postmortem doc and add repro steps. For now, monitor for new restarts.

carla_runtime: opened PR #4821 and included unit/integration test to prevent regression. cc @ben_devex

ben_devex: verified no other models hit same pattern in last 24h.

eng_oncall_amy: closing loop once hotfix is in prod and CS confirms customer stability :thumbsup:
